description: Swift source code defining SwiftUI views for configuring channels using dynamic schemas and rendering various input types based on schema definitions.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaForm
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that renders a dynamic form based on a configuration schema. Handles various schema types such as object, array, boolean, number, and string.

classes.name: ChannelConfigForm
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that manages the display of configuration schema for a specific channel, showing a loading indicator or error message if schema is unavailable.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Renders the UI component for a given schema node, choosing the appropriate SwiftUI view based on schema type.

methods.name: renderStringField
methods.description: Renders a text input view, including handling for sensitive (secure) inputs and enums.

methods.name: renderNumberField
methods.description: Renders a numeric input field, supporting both integer and floating point numbers.

methods.name: renderArray
methods.description: Renders a list of items allowing addition and removal, based on an array schema.

methods.name: renderAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Handles rendering of additional dynamic key-value pairs for schemas that allow extra properties.

methods.name: stringBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding between SwiftUI and configuration values for string type fields.

methods.name: boolBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for boolean configuration values.

methods.name: numberBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for numeric values, supporting both integer and double types.

methods.name: enumBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for selection among enum options.

methods.name: mapKeyBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding to edit keys in a dictionary, supporting renaming keys.
